papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Deep Learning for the Ly$\alpha$ Forest: CNN-Based Absorber Detection and Characterization
papers.excerpt: The Ly$\alpha$ forest is a powerful probe of the intergalactic medium and small-scale matter distribution, but deriving absorber properties traditionally requires computationally expensive Voigt-profile fitting.
papers.tldr: A convolutional neural network (CNN) is presented that identifies and characterizes H i Lyα absorbers directly from quasar spectra and provides a scalable and uncertainty-aware framework for Lyα forest analysis in upcoming spectroscopic surveys.

papers.title: Leveraging Large Language Models to Predict Atomic Oxygen Erosion of Polymers in Low Earth Orbit
papers.excerpt: Low Earth orbit (LEO), home to most active satellites, is projected to undergo a debris-fragmentation cascade known as Kessler Syndrome.

papers.title: Extracting Published Discussions of 13,616 Galaxies with Language Models
papers.comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Artificial Intelligence for Scientific Publications (WASP) 2026
papers.excerpt: Astronomers often have difficulty determining whether an object, such as a star or galaxy of interest, has been discussed in the literature.
papers.tldr: Using language model agents is used to identify galaxies discussed in more than two sentences across a corpus of 156,006 arXiv astro-ph papers and extract those discussions into GalaxyWiki, where users can find literature discussing galaxies, read what was said about them, and follow links to the source papers.
